summary: Insert Formula is redesigned: pick a function, fill a short form with dropdowns, and see the result preview update as you go.
details: Project, reserving class, and dataset are dropdowns, and the dataset list shows only triangles or only vectors to match the function.
Options are checkboxes and period lengths a fixed list; quoting and default arguments are handled for you.
The formula text stays editable and keeps the form in step, and fx on a linked cell opens with its call filled in.
